title: Noether charges and the first law of thermodynamics for multifractional Schwarzschild black hole in the q-derivative theory
summary: In this paper, we investigate black-hole thermodynamics in the multi-fractional theory with $q$-derivatives, focusing on static, spherically symmetric vacuum solutions in the spherical-coordinate approximation. In the geometric frame the solution is exactly Schwarzschild in the areal radius $q$, so that canonical charges can be defined using standard covariant methods. The conserved mass depends only on the Schwarzschild integration constant, and the Iyer--Wald entropy satisfies the usual area law in terms of the geometric horizon radius.
